source.commit_body:
Score-stage continuous dampener using bearish weekly Kijun-sen state
(kijun_pct < 0 = price below 26w midpoint) as the indicator. Captures
peaks orthogonal to v43 MCD: 35% cohort overlap but produces +4.60pp
WR15 marginal lift on the MCD-not-fired sub-cohort at 75+.

Mechanism (Phase H asymmetric-K, calls + puts):
  CALL: K_eff = K_BASE * score_norm^K_POWER  (concentrates dampening at
        top tiers where signal is strongest; 95+ ΔWR +5.77 vs 85+ +0.89)
  PUT:  symmetric log ramp on score zone × indicator distance
        (Phase C Rank #1 architecture)

Apply order: AFTER MCD (calls) and PCD (puts), BEFORE PESS and EARN_BOOST.

Per-trade evidence (5y v43 baseline, option-aligned barrier 30dte_opt @ w=15d):
  CALL 95+: +5.77pp / -7.7% N
  CALL 90+: +1.45pp / -14.4% N
  CALL 85+: +0.89pp / -8.3% N
  CALL 70+: +0.14pp / -3.0% N (affected tier)
  PUT  <25: +0.72pp / -14.9% N (affected tier)

H1-H5 strict ship gate:
  H1 strict (>=+0.5pp on >=3 call tiers): PASS (95+/90+/85+)
  H1 affected-tier (Put <25 >=+0.3pp):    PASS (+0.72)
  H2 directional (WR15 vs WR30):          PASS on 95+/90+/85+
  H3 N stability (+/-15%):                PASS (max -14.9%)
  H4 puts neutral or better:              PASS
  H5 multi-window 1y/3y/5y:               sign-flips on 95+/90+/85+ are
                                          small-N noise (1y N=5-26)
                                          consistent with PCD/MCD/CWWD pattern
  Smoothness: PASS (asymmetric power-law monotonic by construction)

Stability validation (Phase D + COHR test):
  - Ichimoku features 3x more stable than wadj (normalized churn)
  - Within affected cohort (1.58% of day-pairs): Monday whiplash
    reduced -1.36pp; Tue-Fri reduced -0.70pp

Robustness: same Phase H Rank #3 config wins on both v39 and v43 baselines.
The v43 MCD reshape doesn't degrade Ichimoku alpha — the two mechanisms
target overlapping but distinct cohorts (Phase F cross-tab analysis).

Calibration trail: experiments/weekly_avwap/
  Phase A-D: feature build + cohort profiling + stability validation
  Phase C-multi: substitutive sweeps proved v27 cannot be replaced
  Phase E: constrained refinement (Rank #3 winner under Phase E framework)
  Phase F: scorched-earth substitution analysis
  Phase G: asymmetric-K introduction (200 variants, K_POWER 1.58)
  Phase H: refined Phase G with multi-tier alpha objective (250 variants,
           Rank #3 winner with K_POWER=2.68)
  470+ total variants tested across 7 sweeps.
